Preserve the original people, kits, colours, flags and crests exactly as depicted, with stable anatomy and hyperrealistic detail. Coherent motion only, no new elements, no text, narration or music; the football setting and its referential, illustrative nature remain intact.

prompts.title: Lateral Tracking Along the Pitch
prompts.prompt: Take the input football image as the fixed reference and animate it with a smooth lateral tracking move: the camera slides sideways in one continuous, damped motion, producing restrained parallax between foreground players and the background stands. Over 6 seconds in vertical 9:16, any visible ball or player movement stays physically coherent — grounded steps, natural weight shifts, believable ball roll — while faces remain legible and the lower frame stays free for subtitles. Preserve the original people, kits, colours, flags and crests without alteration; stable anatomy throughout, hyperrealistic rendering. Animate only what the reference image supports: no new characters, events, scores or identities. No generated text, narration or music; the football setting and its referential, illustrative character are fully maintained.
